blocks.text: Scott Creek home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

12 houses sold in Scott Creek with a median price of $1,526,500 (the middle half sold between $1,306,250 and $1,670,000), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 96.5% of the last list price; 25% sold above list. They had a median $436 per square foot, a median year built of 1988 and a median lot of 6,022 square feet. 9 townhomes sold in Scott Creek with a median price of $1,049,900 (the middle half sold between $999,900 and $1,090,000), taking a median of 2 days to sell at 100.0% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $696 per square foot, a median year built of 2026 and a median strata fee of $424 a month.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Scott Creek?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 4 houses and 7 condos and townhomes listed in Scott Creek. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Scott Creek a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 25% on only 4 listed, too few to read as a market type. The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Scott Creek from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 4 houses and 7 condos and townhomes sold in Scott Creek over those 5 months; detached houses peaked in June with 2 sold and condos and townhomes peaked in August with 4 sold.

faq.q: How big is Scott Creek compared with the rest of Coquitlam?
faq.a: In October 2026, Scott Creek held 1.1% of the 378 detached houses listed in Coquitlam and 0.9% of the 779 condos and townhomes listed in Coquitlam.

faq.q: What mix of houses and condos is for sale in Scott Creek?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses made up 36.4% of the 11 homes listed in Scott Creek and condos and townhomes made up 63.6%; of the 1 that sold, houses were 100.0% and condos and townhomes 0.0%.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Scott Creek than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses was 2 in June and 4 in October 2026, too few (under 3) to call a rise or fall; condos and townhomes rose from 3 in June to 7 in October 2026 (+133.3%).

faq.q: What did houses in Scott Creek sell for?
faq.a: 12 houses sold in Scott Creek between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,526,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Scott Creek?
faq.a: The median was 18 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.5% of the last list price (25% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
